name: @xiaopb/dsh-mobile-layout
description: DSH web-UI plugin: phone-portrait layout shell. Keeps the official AppFrame untouched on desktop, and on phone portrait switches the sidebar to an off-canvas drawer, adds a 56px persistent action bar under the composer (new / sessions / files / images / plugins / more), keeps permission and model controls in the composer row, and folds the header tools into a compact corner. All overrides are scoped to html[data-dshm-mode="mobile"] and fall back to the official layout when anchors are missing.
author: XiaoPb
